title: The gate classifier gives the secrets class to a gate that only names the Python tokenize module, or by the path of a kb article about secrets
goal: A gate whose text only names the Python tokenize module (tokenize, tokenizer) is classed design, and a gate on an item whose touches name a Markdown article under kb/ whose path holds a secrets word (the auth article shamir-secret-sharing.md) is classed by its own text, not secrets by that path; a token, secret, credential or password in the gate's text (API token, GITLAB_TOKEN) and a touch of a credential or token file (.env, credentials.json, api.token) keep the secrets class.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;sys.exit(0 if a.derived_class({'touches':[]},{'id':'g1','question':'Use the tokenize module or a regex scan?','options':['tokenize','regex']})=='design' else 1)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import bl_authority as a
item=dict(touches=['kb/public/auth/shamir-secret-sharing.md'])
g=dict(id='g1',question='Which anchor rows of the article does the fix keep: the old rows or the reworded ones?',options=['keep the old rows','replace them with the reworded rows'])
bad=dict(id='g2',question='Should the worker read the credential file .env to fetch the value?',options=['read it','leave it'])
c1,c2=a.derived_class(item,g),a.derived_class(item,bad)
print('wording choice on a secrets-named article:',c1,'| credential file gate:',c2)
sys.exit(0 if c1=='design' and c2=='secrets' else 1)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_authority as a
def c(q, t=()):
    return a.derived_class({'touches': list(t)}, {'id': 'g1', 'question': q, 'options': ['a', 'b']})
r = dict(tokenize=c('Use the tokenize module or a regex scan?'),
         tokenizer=c('Which tokenizer splits the words of a fact?'),
         api=c('Use the tokenize module to find the API token?'),
         env_var=c('Where is GITLAB_TOKEN read from?'),
         dotenv=c('Which anchor rows stay?', ['kb/public/auth/x.md', 'config/.env']),
         cred_json=c('Which anchor rows stay?', ['kb/public/auth/credentials.json']),
         token_file=c('Which anchor rows stay?', ['kb/public/auth/api.token']))
print(r)
ok = r['tokenize'] == r['tokenizer'] == 'design' and all(r[k] == 'secrets' for k in r if k not in ('tokenize', 'tokenizer'))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
